title: Multiscale simulations of folded and intrinsically disordered region-containing protein condensates.
authors: Dorosh, Lyudmyla; Wille, Holger; Stepanova, Maria
one_liner_zh: 该文用多尺度模拟研究TDP-43和朊蛋白的相分离凝聚体，虽涉及蛋白组装与离子介导互作，但对象非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，方法可迁移性有限，仅间接相关。
abstract: We present a multiscale simulation framework that integrates all-atom (AA) structure modeling, coarse-grained (CG) Martini 3 simulations, and AA backmapping to investigate supramolecular assembly behaviors of proteins implicated in misfolding diseases. As representative systems, we modeled the C-terminal domain of human TDP-43 (residues 274-414) and a broad region of white-tailed deer prion protein (PrP) (residues 24-233), both associated with misfolding-related pathologies and exhibiting distinct structural features. This AA-CG-AA framework enables the construction and analysis of large multiunit assemblies using two Martini 3-based CG parameter sets that differ in their treatment of nonbonded interactions, including electrostatic cutoffs and the scaling of interactions involving Na(+) and Cl(-) ions present in solution. The framework successfully captured key mesoscale features of early supramolecular condensation and revealed pronounced condition-dependent differences in both condensate morphology and chain dynamics. Parameter sets with longer cutoffs and rescaled ion interactions promoted more interconnected, network-like assemblies-particularly for PrP-whereas standard cutoffs yielded more dispersed systems with higher translational mobility. Mean-square displacement analysis and diffusivity estimates reflected clear differences in translational mobility consistent with varying degrees of local association. Further analysis of low-mean-square-displacement chains revealed the emergence of condensate-like subpopulations, especially in PrP, where percolation-like networks formed. Solvent-accessible surface area analyses confirmed that protein chains remained solvent exposed throughout, consistent with known fluid-like phase-condensation behavior. Follow-up AA analysis revealed persistent interchain dynamical coupling even in the absence of direct chain contacts, suggesting solvent-mediated interactions. Notably, analyses revealed an inverse relationship between protein translational mobility and Na(+) and Cl(-) ion contact counts, suggesting that ion association contributes to early-stage condensation. These findings demonstrate the potential of integrated CG-AA simulation strategies to probe supramolecular condensation in structurally heterogeneous protein systems and support their continued development for studying misfolding-driven assembly processes at mesoscopic scales.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种多尺度模拟框架，整合了全原子（AA）结构建模、粗粒化（CG）Martini 3模拟以及AA反向映射，以研究与错误折叠疾病相关的蛋白质的超分子组装行为。作为代表性系统，我们模拟了人类TDP-43的C端结构域（残基274-414）和白尾鹿朊蛋白（PrP）的广泛区域（残基24-233），两者均与错误折叠相关病理有关，并表现出不同的结构特征。该AA-CG-AA框架利用两套基于Martini 3的CG参数集，构建并分析大型多单元组装体，这些参数集在非键相互作用的处理上有所不同，包括静电截断以及溶液中Na(+)和Cl(-)离子相互作用的缩放。该框架成功捕获了早期超分子凝聚的关键介观特征，并揭示了凝聚体形态和链动力学中显著的条件依赖性差异。具有较长截断和重标度离子相互作用的参数集促进了更互联的网络状组装体——尤其是对于PrP——而标准截断则产生更分散、平移迁移率更高的系统。均方位移分析和扩散率估计反映了平移迁移率的明显差异，与局部关联程度的变化一致。对低均方位移链的进一步分析揭示了类凝聚体亚群的出现，尤其是在PrP中，形成了类似渗流的网络。溶剂可及表面积分析确认蛋白质链始终暴露于溶剂中，这与已知的流体状相凝聚行为一致。后续AA分析揭示了即使在缺乏直接链接触的情况下也存在持续的链间动态耦合，表明存在溶剂介导的相互作用。值得注意的是，分析揭示了蛋白质平移迁移率与Na(+)和Cl(-)离子接触计数之间的反比关系，表明离子关联有助于早期凝聚。这些发现证明了集成CG-AA模拟策略在探测结构异质性蛋白质系统中的超分子凝聚方面的潜力，并支持其持续发展以研究介观尺度上错误折叠驱动的组装过程。
